gen-gf-gaegu-fs-synonym: Marker-bright and loose, Gaegu leads with a friendly, chisel-notched hand. And Synonym follows in a plain sans stripe of ink, so give its size a little extra room and it will hold up nicely.
gen-gf-gaegu-outfit: Outfit reads like bent cable, smooth and uniform, with curves that stop short of closing. And Gaegu's casual pen-and-paper letters loosen it up on top, a pairing that feels best when the text stays brief.
gen-gf-gaegu-plus-jakarta-sans: Gaegu writes like a marker in a relaxed hand, inviting and warm. Big and short is where it earns its keep, while Plus Jakarta Sans sits below in precise monoline strokes with curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-gaegu-sora: A marker-like line with notched openings gives Gaegu its casual charm. Sora below is geometric and precise, so a modest bump in its size is worth trying, since its c and s stay widely parted.
gen-gf-galindo-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Galindo above it is a commanding display face, while Rowan handles the text, better suited to brief copy than endless pages.
gen-gf-geostar-fs-rowan: Rowan is literary and friendly, with open curves and thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones, though it was not meant for long paragraphs. Geostar does the shouting, widely tracked and bold, while Rowan does the talking.
gen-gf-geostar-fill-fs-rowan: Rowan has a literary, friendly voice, with generous curve openings and thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones. Shrink Geostar Fill and its wide tracking loses its drama.
gen-gf-girassol-fs-rowan: Commanding without being loud, Girassol shows only light contrast between its verticals and curves, and Rowan follows with a friendly, literary serif voice. Girassol makes the statement while Rowan carries the words.
gen-gf-give-you-glory-fs-amulya: Spacious gaps at the ends of its rounded letters give Give You Glory a hand-drawn, graceful look that feels friendly at once. It is best for a handful of lines, while Amulya handles the rest in a modern sans.
